safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that tingling/numbness can involve the shoulder may mislocalize the neurologic complaint (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs distal entrapment) and can reduce the quality of subsequent clinical triage or workup. This is unlikely to directly cause harm but can contribute to diagnostic/management inefficiency.
